working.8: 100 × ₹20 = ₹2,000. The ₹700 is a cost, not a sale.
working.23: ₹10 − ₹7 = ₹3 per tea before rent, salaries and everything else. On a high rent, ₹3 a cup may never add up to enough.
working.24: Snack: ₹100 − ₹70 = ₹30. Tea: ₹25 − ₹8 = ₹17. The snack leaves more per sale — though you may sell far more teas.
